pr100.body:
Extends Cut-In Maker #78 into one connected Character Animator → reusable clip → Cinematic Director workflow. Creators can scrub, pose FK joints, key transforms, undo, save/reload native Animation resources, and see the same edit in two cutscene shots. Director adds keyed canvas pan/rotation/zoom. Original presets and transport remain connected through one additive preset-path resolver; Godot 4.6.1 AnimationPlayer remains the timeline.

**Isolated stack:** targets #78 at `af184380fb690f2c19bac69960b7aacce50f9ff2`. Inspected #96, #85, #95, #30 and #62/#64; no branch merge. New studio namespaces only, plus the small preview resolver. Gameplay, Canal Doorway, saves, canon, project settings and approved sheets are unchanged. Existing ART-08 candidate parts are reused byte-for-byte with pinned provenance. No generation, external asset-service transfer or spending.

Start with the [creator guide](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-03-studio/docs/cin_tools_03/README.md), [native-speed demonstration and captures](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/tree/tools/cin-tools-03-studio/docs/cin_tools_03/captures), [QA](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-03-studio/docs/cin_tools_03/QA.md), [fidelity limits](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-03-studio/docs/cin_tools_03/LIMITATIONS.md), and [handoff](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-03-studio/docs/cin_tools_03/HANDOFF.md). Run `tools/cin_tools_03/studio.tscn`, or use its Mac launcher.

**Validation:** 857 passing headless assertions across 10 suites; 159 passing native-rendered assertions across the isolated Studio/Cut-In Maker suites; zero final scoped script errors. Baseline and byte-preservation checks pass. Native recording contains 190 real post-draw samples over 8.806 seconds, maximum clock drift 0.132 seconds, with a sprite sprint → candidate rig brake/settle and two-shot clip reuse.

**Known validation gap:** broader native Canal/input suites failed with stationary fixtures and timed out (28/57 failed assertions in the complete attempted run). Serial launch and a removed test-only focus warmup did not resolve this. Raw failures and a partial unchanged-baseline probe are retained; the cause is unproven. Their headless counterparts pass. Do not claim full native gameplay certification.

**Draft limits:** flat-art seams, FK limb overlap, unvalidated foot contact and an abrupt sprite/rig drawing-style switch remain visible. No new production gait, IK/mesh rigging, ART-10 completion or campaign integration is claimed. Director seeds two fixed shots; full sequencing/timing/audio remain native Godot authoring. Creator acceptance, Windows and controller/export validation remain pending. Cut-In Maker owner confirmed idle; local audit found no source conflict. Remote story/animation notifications failed to resolve saved paths, so their reservations remain unverified.

Keep draft and unmerged.

pr78.body:
Creators can now edit short cut-ins in Godot's native AnimationPlayer timeline, save the scene, preview it, and run an isolated staircase demonstration that hands off to the existing TR-08 presentation and room loader.

**Stacked dependency:** PR #64 at `ed1875307e21f057add025ebebdec1e3f371e90f`. This separate tooling branch targets the TR-08 branch so the diff contains only additive tooling. PR #64 and PR #74 are unchanged; no Wave 3 integration or merge is performed. The normal gameplay scene, production scripts, player physics, routing, assets and project settings are unchanged.

Included:
- Three editable presets: major biome entrance, boss subject reveal, special transition.
- Native camera composition, character strip, environment, presentation and audio-cue tracks; separate reduced-motion timelines.
- Read-only play/pause/scrub/step preview and a playable R14↔R17 demo. Skip, focus loss and watchdog preserve the accepted transition; death/rebuild yields to checkpoint authority.
- [Authoring guide](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/cin_tools_01/README.md), [TR-08 interfaces](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/cin_tools_01/INTERFACES.md), [QA report](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/cin_tools_01/QA.md), [limitations](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/cin_tools_01/LIMITATIONS.md), and [PM handoff](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/blob/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/agent_handoffs/CIN_TOOLS_01_PM_REPORT.md).
- [Screenshots and real-time captured playback](https://github.com/cappy2yappy/momentum-fractured/tree/tools/cin-tools-01-cutin-maker/docs/cin_tools_01/captures). The silent H.264 video preserves actual post-draw timestamps; it is not a fixed-fps movie export.

Validation on Godot 4.6.1 / macOS Apple M4: **33 headless suites, 2,444 PASS; 7 rendered suites, 777 PASS; real-time capture, 3 PASS; zero failed assertions or script errors.** Approved baseline verification passed. Coverage includes skip across intro/TR-08 phases, focus interruption, reduced motion, missing assets/scenes, repeated reciprocal entry, exactly-once requests, control/camera restoration, saves/checkpoints and existing automatic passage regressions. Commands and raw logs are committed; no generated Godot import/cache artifacts are included.

Draft limitations: ART-08 remains candidate animation. Environment staging, the generic boss subject and unassigned audio cues are explicitly temporary. Only the staircase has a playable integration. Creator visual/editor acceptance and a Windows validation pass remain pending.
